module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Slippage Anomaly Detection on Child Orders
precondition: Child order #3 experiences 5-pip slippage while group average is 0.5 pips.
expected_result: Trade flagged 'SLIPPAGE_ANOMALY'; audit log recorded for broker dispute reconciliation.
actual_result: Execution monitor flags fills with slippage deviating > 3 standard deviations from block average for reconciliation.
